purpose: Test whether a supervised linear discriminant backend can substantially improve absolute cross-script verification without changing the frozen compact encoder.
scientific_role: Performance/backend diagnostic only; LDA is not claimed as the methodological novelty.

important_interpretation.lda_improves_both_and_wgc_remains_better: Useful performance backend and WGC remains complementary.
important_interpretation.lda_improves_both_but_wgc_advantage_disa: Discriminant re-alignment dominates the WGC effect; WGC novelty story becomes weaker.
important_interpretation.lda_gives_little_improvement: Absolute-performance bottleneck is more likely the encoder representation than the cosine backend.
